Identity

Our tagline

Behavioral intelligence
for modern work.

Elevator pitch

The Predictive Index gives organizations clarity and confidence in their people, in every moment that matters. We deliver behavioral intelligence when it counts, grounded in science we’ve refined since 1955 and one of the largest validated behavioral datasets in the world.

Short boilerplate

The Predictive Index (PI) has been advancing behavioral intelligence since 1955, giving organizations clarity and confidence in their people in every moment that matters. Learn more at www.predictiveindex.com.

Long boilerplate

The Predictive Index (PI) has been advancing behavioral intelligence since 1955. PI's science-backed platform brings behavioral and cognitive data into every stage of the employee lifecycle, giving organizations clarity and confidence in their people in every moment that matters. The company's behavioral dataset spans millions of assessments across 90+ countries, one of the largest validated behavioral datasets in the world and a foundation that grows more valuable as AI reshapes how organizations make talent decisions. PI's EFPA-certified methodology is globally recognized and helps organizations make objective, data-driven decisions that reduce bias and predict workplace performance. Learn more at www.predictiveindex.com.

Use the boilerplate word for word. Leave client names out.

Tone & Voice

Our archetype is the Magician. We make the invisible visible. We sound like a sharp colleague who’s on your side.

Wise

We know a lot and explain it simply.

“Most team conflict isn’t personal. It’s behavioral.”

Encouraging

We believe in people. That includes the reader.

“Your team isn’t broken. You’re missing one piece of the picture.”

Practical

We stick to real problems and real steps.

“Compare two people to see how they work together best.”

Before and after

Terminology

How we write our own names. Click a name to copy it.

The company

  1. Capitalize The. Even mid-sentence.
  2. Spell it out first. The Predictive Index (PI). Then use for short.
  3. PI has no periods. Two capitals. Possessive is PI’s.
  4. Never translate either name.

Notthe Predictive IndexPredictive IndexP.I.TPI

Short name or . No article. Write “Ask Obi.”

NotOBIobithe assistant

A trademark. Use the full name every time.

NotBA in client material

Use the full name. Keep it in English.

Reference Profiles

Capitalize all 17 names. Captain, Maverick, Analyzer.

Notcaptainmaverick

Say it right

behavioral intelligence
Lowercase. It describes what we do and is never a product name. Write “Obi delivers behavioral intelligence.”
Partners
Certified consulting firms. Integrations are software connections. Keep the two apart.
Other names
PI Labs · Perspectives · Hire · Inspire · Design

Retired

  • talent optimization→behavioral intelligence
  • PI Assistant→Obi
  • On-Demand Behavioral Intelligence→Obi
  • OBI→Obi

Trademark symbols follow Legal’s guidance for external work. The full product glossary is coming to Notion.

!

Never use unlicensed stock photos from the internet. Use the library or the photo generator.

Photo Attributes & Camera Settings

Format
35mm full frame
Lens
35 or 50mm prime
Aperture
f/1.8 to f/2.8
Film look
Portra 400 with fine grain
Light
Available light from a real source
Angle
Eye level and handheld
Framing
Off center with people half in frame

From the library

106 photos · 12 industries

Look for

  • Faces absorbed in the work
  • Worn clothes and real workplaces
  • Leaders of every age and background
  • Hands caught mid-task

Leave out

  • Everyone smiling at the camera
  • People lined up around a table
  • High fives and handshakes
  • Pointing at screens

Need something new? Beta

Message PI Photo Generator in Slack. Say who’s in the shot and what they’re doing. It sends back photos in this style. Ask Brand Marketing for access.

The people in these photos are generated. Never present them as real customers, employees or partners.

Icons

The 17 Reference Profile icons are our only icon set. Click one to download it.
